title: The Community-Owned Internet Network
short_teaser: Some communities build shared broadband systems when commercial service is insufficient.
story: Some communities build shared broadband systems when commercial service is insufficient. Innovation can be organizational as well as technical. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
